title: Expensive and flimsy
text: Expensive and flimsy. We bought this about a year ago and after one use the cardboard inside just bent so guests could still feel the bars. After that point it was essentially useless. Don't waste your money on this. Instead go to the hardware store and buy their thinnest 48"x48" plywood and a roll of duct tape. Cut the plywood into two pieces that are 24"x48". The hardware store should cut it to size if you ask. Tape all the edges and tape the two prices together and now you have a bar shirked works way better, costs about half the price, and will even fit under the couch for storage.

product_metadata.title: Sleeper Sofa Bar Shield by Improvements
